extraction.Name: Viola H. Gover
extraction.Recorded patent: yes, filed for record; by allottee
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged for $1300.00 to C. E. Vandervoort, Jr.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to C. E. Vandervoort, Jr. for $1300.00; Mortgage due May 1929
extraction.Occupation/Income: Income of $180 per year from inherited land, also annuity paid to Pawnee tribe
extraction.NOTES: Patent No. 61391; delivered by mail Mar 5, 1918; land not sold; five children dependent upon allottee for support; health fair; no property or money accumulated; notarized November 26, 1928, Pawnee County, Oklahoma; commission expires Jan. 31, 1929; note states 'The mortgage on this land should be paid and good title restored in allottee.'
